#[path = "../../crates/flux-arena/src/shared_slice.rs"]
mod shared_slice;
use shared_slice::SharedSlicePool;

fn main() {
    let mut pool = SharedSlicePool::default();
    let first = pool.alloc([1u32, 2, 3]);
    let next = pool.alloc([4u32, 5]);
    let cloned = first.clone();
    assert_eq!(&*next, &[4, 5]);
    for i in 0..300 {
        assert_eq!(pool.alloc([i])[0], i);
    }
    let large = pool.alloc(0..300);
    let part = first.slice(1..3);
    drop((first, pool));
    assert_eq!(&*cloned, &[1, 2, 3]);
    assert_eq!(&*part, &[2, 3]);
    assert_eq!(large.len(), 300);
    let mut empty = SharedSlicePool::<()>::default();
    assert!(empty.alloc([]).is_empty());
    assert_eq!(empty.alloc([(); 300]).len(), 300);
    println!("shared slices {} {} {}", cloned[0], part[1], large[299]);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod additional_controls {
    use super::*;
    struct WrongEmpty(bool);
    impl Iterator for WrongEmpty {
        type Item = u32;
        fn next(&mut self) -> Option<u32> {
            if self.0 {
                self.0 = false;
                Some(7)
            } else {
                None
            }
        }
        fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
            (0, Some(0))
        }
    }
    impl ExactSizeIterator for WrongEmpty {}
    #[test]
    fn malicious_empty_iterator_is_rejected() {
        let mut pool = SharedSlicePool::default();
        assert!(
            std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| pool.alloc(WrongEmpty(true))))
                .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(&*pool.alloc([9]), &[9]);
    }
}
